name: new_document
description: Create a new .docx from a template (blank|report|memo|letter|proposal|invoice|technical-spec|research-paper|novel|newsletter; default blank, an empty page) at outPath inside an allowed folder (a template is a starting document with styles, page setup, header and footer and bracketed placeholders such as [Client name]; every part can be edited afterwards). Optional page {size,orientation,margins} as in pageSetup (size: name or "148x210mm", 1 in to 22 in a side); the template is built for it. pageSize was replaced by page.size. (the folders named with --allowed-dir or ASTRA_EXTRA_DOC_ROOTS; only when none are named, ./documents and the system temp folder). Validates the fresh package before writing (E_VALIDATION when invalid, never writes corruption); refuses to overwrite without {force:true} (E_CONFLICT). Success returns {ok:true,path,sessionId,revision,template,bytes} with the file opened into a session (use sessionId for inspect/execute_batch/save). Example {"outPath":"documents/new-report.docx","template":"report"}. Session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>, DEPRECATED to supply sessionId: client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION; deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids). IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions. Optional styleGuide (bundled guide name or guide .md path, jailed to the document folder; remote URLs fail closed) attaches a house style to the session at creation: later batches inherit its table/chart/callout defaults, inspect_document shows its compact summary, save_document reports advisory styleWarnings. Guides cannot be detached afterwards: open a new session to work without a guide. Unknown names fail with E_VALIDATION naming the available set.

page.description: Page: size, orientation, margins. Default Letter portrait.

sessionId.description: DEPRECATED: session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>); omit sessionId and use the returned id. Client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION (deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids).
